main_issue: Whether and when the small room can be reserved for Agent D's daily prayers (and a prayer mat kept there) given others' needs for the room

A-B.evidence: A accepted 1 p.m. and 3:30 (T16); B proposed moving files out (T17) and asked if it works for everyone (T19); they never addressed each other directly, but both back the final arrangement.

A-C.evidence: A agrees to 1 p.m. and 3:30 (T1, T16); C agrees to 1:15 and endorses the files solution (T7, T18); no direct exchange, both support the final plan.

A-D.evidence: A objected to 4:30 and 3:45 (T1, T3, T14); D offered 4, 3:45 and 3:30 (T2, T8, T15); A: '3:30 works. Thanks.' (T16).

B-C.evidence: C: 'That sounds like a good solution' to B's file-moving proposal (T18).

B-D.evidence: B worried about file access (T4, T9, T12) and D insisted on no interruption (T13); B proposed moving files out (T17) and D said 'Yes, that works. Thank you.' (T21).

C-D.evidence: C said 1 p.m. was a problem (T5); C offered 1:15 for D (T7); D: 'Yes, 1:15 works for me' (T8); C backed the final plan (T18).
